name: t101
summary: Segment and pedestal glass now reads dark green-blue: about 1 window in 12 is lit (all warm), and gray_concrete backs every other tower glass cell. The segment's corner strips are now sea lanterns behind light blue glass. On the pedestal, the corner noses and the hall glass above street level no longer glow. The ruyi at each face's foot is now 10 wide x 12 tall, and a small ruyi sits in each corner notch at the foot. Massing, plots and stacking are unchanged.

revisions.comment:
Taipei 101 reads as itself (the eight flared segments, pedestal, coins, crown and spire all line up when stacked); three things for the hero render at dusk from Elephant Mountain:
1. THE GLASS MUST READ GREEN-BLUE, NOT WHITE: in the dusk render the tower glows white because far too many windows are lit. Keep only about 1 lit window in 12 on the segments and pedestal (warm, scattered), and make the rest of the glass a dark-to-mid GREEN-BLUE: cyan stained glass (panes or blocks) over a dark backing (no light behind it), with the darker floor bands kept. The mall can keep its lit shop windows at street level only.
2. LIGHT IT AS THE REAL BUILDING: the light comes from (a) continuous vertical light strips up the four flared corners of every segment (sea lanterns or shroomlight behind light blue stained glass, one block wide, the full height of each segment), (b) the lit band along each segment's top ledge (keep), (c) the observatory floors and the pinnacle lit brightly (keep), (d) uplights on the four coin medallions. Nothing else glows.
3. THE RUYI: make the ruyi ornament at the foot of each face of the segment larger and readable from far away (about 9 wide and 12 tall, pale iron block / quartz, 1 deep, standing proud of the glass), and add the same small ornament at each segment's four corners where the corner notch meets the ledge.
Keep the massing, the flare, the 62/76 squares, the plot sizes and the stacking exactly as they are.
revisions.summary: Segment and pedestal glass now reads dark green-blue: about 1 window in 12 is lit (all warm), and gray_concrete backs every other tower glass cell. The segment's corner strips are now sea lanterns behind light blue glass. On the pedestal, the corner noses and the hall glass above street level no longer glow. The ruyi at each face's foot is now 10 wide x 12 tall, and a small ruyi sits in each corner notch at the foot. Massing, plots and stacking are unchanged.
applied: 1. Lit windows: in parts/dusk.mjs I cut litClump density on the pedestal and segment from 0.12 to 0.03 (doubled on S/E). Measured, that leaves about 8% of glass lit (segment 563 of about 6,700 glass cells), so roughly 1 in 12. Every cool pearlescent window there is now warm ochre.

1. Dark backing: a new backing() step in dusk puts gray_concrete in every air cell just inside the cyan and light blue tower glass, following each band's notched plan, on the pedestal (y 3..154) and segment (y 1..43). The renders show dark-to-mid green-blue glass, with the dark_prismarine floor bands kept.
1. Mall: lit windows are kept for the street-level shop windows only (litClump box limited to y 3..10). The upper-storey lit bays are gone.

2a. Corner strips: in parts/segment.mjs each segment's four flared corners now carry a continuous strip, y 1..45 in every band, stepping out with the flare. It is light_blue_stained_glass on the (2,2) nose with a sea_lantern in the cell diagonally inside it (it was ochre_froglight).

2. 'Nothing else glows': in parts/pedestal.mjs the pedestal's (2,2) corner froglights are now light_gray_concrete like the other noses. The froglights behind the N and E hall glass are removed above y 12, so the halls are lit at street level only.
2b, 2c, 2d: the segment ledge lit band, the brightly lit observatory and pinnacle, and the coin medallion shroomlight uplights are unchanged, as asked.

3. Face ruyi: replaced with a 10 x 12 cloud scroll (x/z 33..42). It is iron_block with a smooth_quartz outline on the head and gray_concrete eyes, 1 deep. The stem and foot stand 1 proud of the inset-7 wall and the head stands 1 proud of the inset-6 wall above.

3. Corner ruyi: added a small one at each of the segment's four corners, in the double-sawtooth notch at the foot where it meets the ledge below. It is a 6-tall iron and quartz stem and head wrapping the corner and resting on the outer noses.
skipped: Ruyi width: it is 10 wide instead of 9. A 9-wide ornament can't be centred on the even 76 box (centre 37.5), so I went to 10, the nearest centred size.

Corner ruyi placement: I read 'where the corner notch meets the ledge' as the foot corner, the same height as the face ruyi, standing on the ledge below. Because of that it covers the bottom 5 courses of each corner light strip at the inset-7 band.

Kept glowing, though not on your list: the pedestal's top lit band (y 155..156) and the street-level lobby lights in the pedestal halls. I treated them like the segment ledge band and the mall's street-level shop windows. The segment's foot-floor sea lanterns (inside the hollow, now hidden behind the backing) also stay.

Check results: the structure check found no floating blocks. It reports 48 unsupported foot-floor sea lanterns and froglight orphans by the pedestal halls (8 shown, 299 counted), all from parts this pass didn't touch. The palette check's flags are all on existing elements (gold coin, roof garden, uplights, pinnacle lights), so I left them.
